Patient: I've been having some joint pain, mainly in my knees and feet, but it's been manageable. I do notice some stiffness, especially after sitting for a long time at my desk. It doesn't interfere too much with my daily routine, but I do have days where it's a bit worse, especially when I'm moving around more. Doctor: Could you provide details about any recent changes in your symptoms, such as increased pain, swelling, or stiffness, and whether there have been any flare-ups in the past month? Patient: I haven't had any real flare-ups lately, but there were a couple of days where I took an extra prednisone because my feet were a little more painful, especially on days when I was moving around more. Additionally, have you experienced any side effects from these medications? Patient: I'm currently on methotrexate, and I've been taking it for a while now. I also used to be on prednisone, but I'm down to just one pill now, and I've been trying to wean off it. The only side effect I've noticed is these bruises that show up when I bump myself, and I didn't feel them happening. I didn't know it was related to the prednisone.
